lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, with the highest intensity nodes concentrated in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a series of rectangular segments where the circular blobs serve as intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high intensity on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial frequency observed toward the anterior margin of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin features a high density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance clusters distinct from the larger, more ordered blobs on the main flank.
